text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Line Craft felt in her heart that she had 
put on a great run. Her fellow Umamusume 
of the same generation acknowledge her 
strength as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She felt as though she could get even 
faster. ...Unlike that medium-distance 
training, which had been nothing but pure 
agony.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"And that was precisely why Rhein Kraft 
had lost sight of which path she should 
take."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next goal is the first crown of the 
Triple Tiara, the Oka Sho... However, she 
could not envision what lay beyond it.
